title: Phase foundational bead index
$comment: Authored phase definition (user ruling 2026-09-26): the membership rows are the phase; the optional keys hold phase facts that are not in beads. sprint-report, DAG generation, check-phase-artifact and validate-plan share validate_index. Dev and sanity IDs must be unique, distinct from each other and the root, and resolve to a valid live pair. Undeclared keys and copied bead fields are rejected.
description: Defines which beads make up a phase: the root bead and one dev/sanity pair per sprint. This file is authored and committed by the planner in the plan PR; it is never generated from beads and beads are never generated from it. validate-plan requires the children of the root to be exactly these pairs. It never duplicates bead content or execution state; optional phase facts that have no bead field live here.

root_bead_id.description: Phase root bead ID. Phase identity and integration branch are read from this bead.

sprints.description: One pair per current planned sprint: five sprints means five entries referencing five dev beads and five triage/sanity beads. Absorbed work is not a separate sprint.

integration_branch.description: Phase integration branch when it is not recorded on the root bead.

review_artifacts.description: Repository paths of plan-review artifacts (e.g. the phase DAG HTML) beyond the defaults.

human_gates.description: Gate bead IDs of type human that the user explicitly agreed to place in this phase. A phase runs unattended; any other human gate blocking phase work is a validate-plan problem.

waivers.description: Past state violations the user accepted in the plan PR (a sanity reopened after PASS, a dev bead started before its blocker closed, a PASS that got no QA). validate-plan prints each as a warning instead of a problem. History is not rewritten; the waiver is the record.

policy.description: Phase-wide policy agreed with the user.

dev_bead_id.description: Sprint development bead ID. Read labels, scope, dependencies, ordering, ownership and state from the bead.

sanity_bead_id.description: Paired triage/sanity gate bead ID. The live bead must block on this entry's dev bead; its criteria, verdict and state are not copied here.
